note: Binary file handle (Native). Idiom everywhere: `File f = new File(path); if (f.open(File.MODE_WRITE)) { f.write(...); f.close(); }`, paths are relative to the game root with forward slashes (`save/temp/`, `save/cars/`, `save/controls/`). Binary format with an 8-byte `SDAT` header, raw little-endian ints/floats and u32-length-prefixed NUL-terminated strings (measured, see java.io.md). Save-game format = sequence of write(int/float/String/ResourceRef) calls, read back with readInt/readFloat/readString/readResID in the same order; every file starts with a magic int and a version int (GameLogic SAVEFILEID_MAIN 0x87654321, version 21 (loads >= 20)). finalize() closes the file.
`open(File.MODE_READ=0 or MODE_WRITE=1)` returns non-zero on success; used as an `if` condition.
Closes; safe to call twice (finalize also closes).
